adaptive_rationale: The prior complete-cost study was negative. Its independent byte_sum controls had delivery totals base=1385654382 ns, guarded=1193196153 ns and guarded-narrowed=1282785779 ns, but candidate preparation outweighed these finite delivery savings. This follow-up chooses only byte_sum and a longer fixed horizon after observing those data. It is adaptive, not an unbiased confirmation. packet_xor and its negative results remain reported in the predecessor study.
execution_order: Three cyclic Latin groups: base/guarded/guarded-narrowed, guarded/guarded-narrowed/base, guarded-narrowed/base/guarded. All use the same fixed new seed 197.
admission: Each episode owns an independent fresh session. Baseline is proved, built and sealed anew; candidate arms additionally propose, independently prove, build and seal the selected candidate. No prior proof or receipt is imported. Exactly 256 deliveries use the existing max_executions=256 bound, including 32 guard-fallback deliveries at n=4097.
cost_scope: All episode preparation, proofs, compilation, sealing, native-text inspection, lease/image checks, actual execution, independent checksum checks, sample/receipt/raw-result evidence writes and session cleanup are timed. Source/tool admission, one real driver build, dispatch, cost-only writes and final identity checks are charged once to every standalone arm. Nested native-driver and delivery metrics are explanatory and never added twice.
excluded_costs: final pairwise analysis and aggregate encoding
acceptance: All nine episodes must pass output, budget, fresh-proof, distinct-candidate-native-text, exact execution-count and complete-release checks with unchanged source/tools. Each candidate passes only if all three paired baseline-minus-candidate complete episode costs are strictly positive. The overall observed cost gate requires both candidates to pass. Means cannot override a nonpositive pair. Statistical superiority, universal performance and legacy-application wins remain unestablished.
prior_costs: Preserve the predecessor failed sandbox study, successful host study, both builds and two startup diagnostics: tracked total 199343918199 ns. Report them separately and add this study time for a cumulative tracked total; do not subtract, rescore or hide prior failures.
ndu_scope: No NDU controller is exercised or reranked here. This study can establish a bounded candidate-reuse observation only and cannot establish NDU incremental value.
